services.name: Panic Escape Room
services.desc: This is NOT your typical escape room! Compete to WIN CASH PRIZES in a multiplayer escape room competition played entirely online. We were heavily inspired by our favorite games like the Legend of Zelda, Pokemon, and other retro classics.Teams race to solve 5 rooms with puzzles and challenges in order to escape the fastest. The average escape time is 54 minutes. Each player controls their own avatar character where they can move, interact, and pick up objects to successfully escape. Prizes will depend on the total number of teams registered. If fewer than 200 teams compete, then a proportional amount of prize money may be awarded or additional competition days may be added to allow for more
